instruction: Create a screenshot of the video scene, name it 'vlc_capture.png', and put it on Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 7: Filename references VLC 'vlc_capture.png'. Uses 'create' verb.
metadata.verification: Task requires taking a VLC screenshot and saving to vlc_capture.png. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Desktop/vlc_capture.png.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete semantic verification: Getter extracts file existence, PNG format validation (via magic bytes check), file size (> 1KB), and valid image dimensions using the 'file' command.

Correct coverage: Metric checks ALL requirements - file must exist, be a valid PNG (magic bytes 89504e470d0a1a0a), have reasonable size, and have valid image dimensions (PNG image data with width x height).
Correct parameter handling: Metric properly accesses expected.get('exists') directly (when type='rule', expected IS the rules dict returned by get_rule).
Prevents false positives: Returns 1.0 only if ALL conditions are met (exists AND is_png AND has_valid_size AND has_valid_dimensions), preventing empty/corrupted/non-image files from passing.
Logical correctness: The implementation will correctly verify at runtime that a valid PNG screenshot was created, not just any file with the correct name.
Appropriate verification depth: For a screenshot task, verifying PNG format, size, and dimensions is semantically sufficient without needing pixel-level content analysis.
